meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构优化机会,生成可视化报告并深入剖析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护日渐庞杂的代码库,想找到架构改进的发力点
copy.tagline_en: Scan your codebase for architecture improvements, then dive into each one
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically uncover architecture improvement areas in your codebase

howto.what: 它扫描代码库找出“深化”机会——把浅模块（接口与实现几乎同样复杂）重构为深模块；将候选用含前后对比图的 HTML 报告展示；你从中挑一个后，它会陪你把该重构方向一步步审问清楚。
howto.when: 当用户要求评估代码库架构、点名某个模块/痛点让 Claude 扫描，或要求生成架构候选的 HTML 报告时，技能会接管。

say.text: 扫描代码库，找出值得深化的模块，生成 HTML 报告。
say.note: 会先探索代码库并产出候选卡片。

say.text: 结合最近 commit，优先看改动最频繁的区域有哪些架构问题。
say.note: 会按 git 热点聚焦扫描。

say.text: 我选报告里的第一个候选项，开始深入分析。
say.note: 会进入 grilling 决策流程。

howto.what_en: Scans the codebase for “deepening” opportunities—refactors turning shallow modules into deep ones—presents candidates in an HTML report with before/after diagrams, then walks you through whichever candidate you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for an architecture review to find deepening opportunities, name a module or pain point to scan, or request an HTML report of architecture candidates.

say_en.text: Scan the codebase and build an HTML report of modules worth deepening.
say_en.note: Explores first, then shows candidate cards.

say_en.text: Use recent git history to focus on hot spots and surface architecture issues there.
I'll pick the first candidate from the report—let's dig into it.
